versions.changelog: v1.1.0: post-security-audit + TRACE hardening, all backward-compatible (S1 robust locale fallback, S2 precise version-error hints, Q2/Q3 stderr diagnostics, Q4 TestRobustness, S3 tool scoping, S4 release-doc isolation, Q1 EN-default measure_skill). 46 regression tests green.

v1.0.0 (stable): graduated from 0.x with API frozen. Post-security-audit hardening: separated quoted standard text from opinionated defaults, narrowed trigger scope with negative guards, disclosed locale env vars (LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG read-only) and no side effects, labeled dev-only tooling. 37 regression tests pass.
v0.2.0 (2026-10-11): i18n en/zh support; English-default SKILL.md with Language section per ClawHub NL policy; bilingual locale files; reference docs mirrored to English; 37 tests pass.
